_comment: AI Cockpit — free-tier quota config. Read by workers.php's usage_with_quota action. Edit any entry directly, or use the Edit Quota dialog in the UI. Schema: per-provider object with 'kind' (daily_requests | credit_based | consumption_only), 'anchor' (midnight_utc | calendar_first_of_month | rolling_24h), 'last_verified_at' (date string for the staleness badge), 'models' (per-model limits with optional '*' wildcard fallback). last_verified_at older than 30 days triggers an amber 'verify' hint in the UI.
_authoritative_source: Groq's authoritative per-account limits live at https://console.groq.com/settings/limits — the values here are public defaults verified 2026-05-09.

groq.notes: Free tier hits whichever cap arrives first: RPM, TPM, RPD. RPD is the binding constraint for most users. Limits are per-organization, NOT per API key.
